answer: A data vault buying comet images or falcon counts can issue a unique task ticket before work starts and pay once per ticket after checking its evidence. Agent names carry no reward weight. A sybil swarm must therefore capture additional assigned observations, paying sensor, travel, and time costs, instead of reselling the same file under fresh names. Random location and time challenges make replay harder. Ticket hoarding and forged sensor data remain possible, so short expiries and spot audits help, although compromised auditors can still admit fraud.
